methodology: FV-1.16 layered valuation: cycle-normalized EPS from complete annual observations, consistent EPS/BVPS ROE for Residual Income, a shared recovery run-rate rule for cyclical turnarounds, refined industry/theme peer multiples with clipped outliers, and a capped forward EPS scenario; the ensemble uses a weighted arithmetic center with base weights of RI 45%, DDM 25%, P/B 20%, P/E 20% and forward EPS 10%, renormalized for missing models; when TTM ROE exceeds Ke, up to 10 percentage points are transferred from P/B to P/E and forward EPS; normalized EPS does not extend trough decline as perpetual growth; recovery-class issuers blend two positive improving quarters annualized with TTM EPS and disable trough peer P/E and its derived forward model, using RI plus P/B; current price is used only for market-implied diagnostics; newer evidenced company EPS updates may replace stale formal warehouse data for the same period, while older or undocumented updates are rejected; forward EPS requires six TTM observations, revenue/EPS evidence and a 2.5x cap; Residual Income applies a Ke-minus-terminal-growth convergence gate of at least 2%; DDM requires at least 1% dividend yield and P/B requires BVPS at least 1

warnings: 中央銀行 API 暫時無法取得：SSLError，使用官方 fallback
World Bank GDP API 沒有足夠的名目 GDP 序列，使用透明 fallback
Damodaran 國家風險溢酬表未找到 Taiwan，使用已標示版本 fallback
Residual Income 使用與估值 EPS 同基準的 EPS / 最新 BVPS 推導 ROE；季度 ROE 僅作觀察，不作長期 ROE
近一年沒有現金股利資料，留存率按 100% 計算
同業群組（造紙工業）P/B 納入估值集合
同業群組（造紙工業）P/E 納入估值集合
FV-1.16 前瞻 EPS 納入低權重情境集合：最近 6–8 個 TTM EPS 加權線性趨勢，並以已公告季度營收／EPS 強度交叉檢查；2028-Q4 以同業 P/E 評價後折現
景氣反轉類停用低谷同業 P/E 及其衍生前瞻模型；以 Residual Income 與 P/B 估值，避免低谷分母製造假性高估
前瞻 EPS 是模型估算，不是公司已公告 EPS；需至少六個連續 TTM 觀測點，並以同業 P/E 與 Ke 折現

market_implied.interpretation: 現價包含高於模型基本面價值的成長或溢價；此欄位不回饋公允價模型

assumptions.trend: 最近 6–8 個連續 TTM EPS，以後期觀測值較高權重的線性回歸
assumptions.bear_bull: 最近 TTM EPS 季增變化的第 25／75 百分位作為線性斜率情境
assumptions.revenue_anchor: 已公告完整季度營收 × 觀察到的 EPS／營收強度；沒有至少四個重疊觀測季度則停用
assumptions.cap: 每一情境 EPS 不超過最新 TTM EPS 的 2.5 倍，避免短期線性斜率外推成無限本夢比
assumptions.target: 2027-Q4 與 2028-Q4 EPS，未來版本使用 2028-Q4 目標價折現回估值日
